## Entra External ID: customer identity dashboard
Sign-in and audit data from the external tenant. Use the time range below. `ResultType` 0 = success; codes such as 50074/50076 mean MFA was required (interrupted, not a true failure). Dormant-user and first-seen panels use fixed windows (90/180 days) so they ignore the time range.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize TotalSignIns=count(), Successful=countif(ResultType == "0"), Failed=countif(ResultType != "0"),
            UniqueUsers=dcount(UserId), UniqueApps=dcount(AppDisplayName), UniqueIPs=dcount(IPAddress)
| extend SuccessRatePct = round(100.0 * Successful / TotalSignIns, 1)
content.title: Headline numbers

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize Successful=countif(ResultType == "0"), Failed=countif(ResultType != "0") by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Sign-ins over time

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize SignIns=count() by Hour=tostring(hourofday(TimeGenerated))
| order by toint(Hour) asc
content.title: Sign-ins by hour of day (UTC)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), City=tostring(LocationDetails.city),
         Browser=tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), OS=tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, UserDisplayName, AppDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription,
          IPAddress, Country, City, Browser, OS, AuthenticationRequirement, ConditionalAccessStatus, IsInteractive
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Most recent sign-ins (latest 100)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize ActiveUsers=dcount(UserId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Daily active users

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| summarize SignIns=count(), Failed=countif(ResultType != "0"), LastSignIn=max(TimeGenerated),
            FirstSeenInRange=min(TimeGenerated), Apps=make_set(AppDisplayName, 5), Countries=make_set(Country, 5),
            IPs=dcount(IPAddress)
    by UserPrincipalName, UserDisplayName, UserId
| order by LastSignIn desc
content.title: Per-user activity (last sign-in, counts, apps, countries)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated) by UserId
| summarize NewUsers=count() by bin(FirstSeen, 1d)
| order by FirstSeen asc
content.title: First-ever sign-in per day (new users, last 180 days)

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Category == "UserManagement" and OperationName has_any ("Add user", "Create user", "Invite")
| summarize Events=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Result
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: User creation / sign-up events (audit log)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize LastSuccessfulSignIn=max(TimeGenerated), SignIns=count() by UserPrincipalName, UserDisplayName, UserId
| where LastSuccessfulSignIn < ago(30d)
| order by LastSuccessfulSignIn asc
content.title: Dormant users: seen in last 90 days but not in last 30

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize ActiveDays=dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)) by UserId
| summarize Users=count() by ActiveDaysBucket=case(ActiveDays == 1, "1 day", ActiveDays <= 5, "2-5 days", ActiveDays <= 15, "6-15 days", "16+ days")
content.title: Engagement: users by number of active days

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Failures=count(), AffectedUsers=dcount(UserId), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by ResultType, ResultDescription
| order by Failures desc
| take 25
content.title: Failure reasons

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Failures=count(), DistinctIPs=dcount(IPAddress), LastFailure=max(TimeGenerated), Errors=make_set(ResultType, 5) by UserPrincipalName
| where Failures >= 5
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Users with 5+ failed sign-ins

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize Accounts=dcount(UserPrincipalName), Attempts=count(), Failed=countif(ResultType != "0"),
            Country=any(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)) by IPAddress
| where Accounts >= 3 and Failed >= 5
| order by Failed desc
content.title: IPs trying 3+ different accounts (credential stuffing signal)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| summarize Successful=countif(ResultType == "0"), Failed=countif(ResultType != "0") by Country
| extend Total = Successful + Failed
| order by Total desc
| take 20
| project Country, Successful, Failed
content.title: Sign-ins by country

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where isnotempty(Country)
| summarize Countries=make_set(Country), CountryCount=dcount(Country), SignIns=count() by UserPrincipalName
| where CountryCount >= 3
| order by CountryCount desc
content.title: Users signing in from 3+ countries

content.query:
SigninLogs
| mv-expand AuthenticationDetails
| extend Method=tostring(AuthenticationDetails.authenticationMethod), Succeeded=tostring(AuthenticationDetails.succeeded)
| where isnotempty(Method)
| summarize Count=count() by Method, Succeeded
| order by Count desc
content.title: Authentication methods used (MFA, password, etc.)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize SignIns=count() by AuthenticationRequirement
content.title: Authentication requirement

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize SignIns=count() by ConditionalAccessStatus
content.title: Conditional Access result

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize SignIns=count(), Users=dcount(UserId), Failed=countif(ResultType != "0"), LastSignIn=max(TimeGenerated) by AppDisplayName
| extend FailureRatePct = round(100.0 * Failed / SignIns, 1)
| order by SignIns desc
content.title: Sign-ins by application

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend Browser=tostring(split(tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), " ")[0])
| where isnotempty(Browser)
| summarize SignIns=count() by Browser
| order by SignIns desc
| take 10
content.title: Browsers

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend OS=tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem)
| where isnotempty(OS)
| summarize SignIns=count() by OS
| order by SignIns desc
| take 10
content.title: Operating systems

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize SignIns=count() by ClientAppUsed
content.title: Client app type

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize SignIns=count(), Users=dcount(UserId) by ResourceDisplayName
| order by SignIns desc
| take 25
content.title: Resource accessed

content.query:
AuditLogs
| summarize Events=count(), Failures=countif(Result != "success"), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Category, OperationName
| order by Events desc
content.title: Audit events by category and operation

content.query:
AuditLogs
| summarize Events=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Category
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Audit events over time

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName has_any ("password", "credential", "authentication method")
| extend Actor=coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
         Target=tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, ResultReason, Actor, Target
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Password and credential events

content.query:
AuditLogs
| extend Actor=coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
         Target=tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, Category, OperationName, Result, Actor, Target
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Latest 100 audit events
